faq.write_us_prompt: Didn't find your answer? Write to us
faq.question_1: What types of software can you develop?
faq.answer_1: We focus on end-to-end software development, from design to deployment. We build websites and web applications, e-shops, mobile apps for iOS and Android, as well as desktop programs for business and individual use. Our services also include advanced solutions based on artificial intelligence and process automation. In addition, we specialise in integrating various systems (e.g. payment gateways, ERP, CRM or cloud services) and in modifying and improving existing projects. We always look for a way to create or optimise a tailor-made solution that genuinely helps your business.
faq.question_2: How long does it take to build a project?
faq.answer_2: Development time always depends on the scope and complexity of the project. Simpler solutions, such as a presentation website or a smaller company site, can be ready within a few days to two weeks. More demanding projects, such as e-shops, portals or complex web and mobile applications, can take several weeks to months, depending on the number of features, design requirements and integrations with other systems. After the initial consultation, we will prepare a realistic timeline with milestones so you know exactly how development will progress and when you can expect the launch.
faq.question_3: How much does it cost to develop a website or an app?
faq.answer_3: The price always depends on the scope and complexity of the project. A simple presentation website will cost differently from a full-featured e-shop or a complex application with integrations and advanced features. The final amount is also influenced by the choice of technologies, design complexity, security requirements or connections to other systems. That is why we assess each project individually and, after the initial consultation, prepare an exact quote together with a timeline. Transparency goes without saying – you always know what you are paying for, and we offer different solution variants according to your budget and priorities. This lets you choose the path that best fits your needs and financial possibilities.
faq.question_4: How does the collaboration usually work?
faq.answer_4: We start our collaboration with an initial consultation, where we listen to your needs, goals and notes. Based on this information, we prepare a solution proposal – it includes the choice of suitable technologies, technical specifications, a design and feature proposal, a completion timeline and a price quote. We present this plan to you for approval. Once everything is agreed, we move on to the actual development, testing and subsequent launch of the project. Throughout the process, we keep you informed about progress, involve you in key decisions and make sure you have full control over the result.
faq.question_5: Do you also provide long-term support and maintenance?
faq.answer_5: Yes, we provide long-term support and maintenance, because we know that the work does not end with the launch of a project. Our services include regular updates of systems and libraries, performance and security monitoring, operational monitoring, data backups and optimisation according to current needs. In case of problems or new requirements, we respond quickly and flexibly so you can be sure your solution will remain stable, secure and fully functional in the future. We can also help you extend functionality or integrate new technologies, so your project can keep evolving together with your business.
faq.question_6: Do you also modify existing applications?
faq.answer_6: Yes, we don't always have to start from scratch. We often work on modifications and improvements of existing applications or websites. This may involve extending functionality, modernising an outdated look, increasing speed and performance, improving security or adding integrations with other systems. If you have a project that already works but needs to be taken to the next level, we can take it over, analyse its current state and propose the best way to improve it.

services.info_header_2: what are the steps in software development
services.show_projects_header: Take a look at our completed projects.
services.service_main_text:
We develop custom software for companies that need more than an off-the-shelf solution. Web applications and systems, desktop tools for Windows, macOS or Linux, mobile apps for iOS and Android — always built on our own code, adapted to your processes and designed to grow with your business.

It doesn't matter whether it's an internal company system, a customer portal, an e-shop or a complex CRM. Every project starts with an analysis of your real needs, not a template. The result is a solution that works exactly where you need it — whether in the browser, on the desktop or in your pocket.

cards.custom_text: We don't work with templates. We build every solution from the ground up exactly according to your processes — whether it's a web application, a desktop tool or a mobile app.
cards.auth_text: Every multi-user system gets secure login and management of roles and permissions. You decide who can see and edit what.
cards.seo_text: We deliver web solutions technically optimised for search engines — proper structure, loading speed, meta tags and sitemap. The foundation for organic traffic.
cards.hosting_text: We take care of server deployment, SSL certificate setup, a CI/CD pipeline and basic monitoring. Launch isn't extra work — it's part of the project.
cards.integrations_text: We connect your new software with what you already have — ERP, accounting, payment gateways, e-mailing or any API. No manual data transfers.
cards.security_text: Data encryption, protection against common attacks, proper handling of personal data. We address security from the start, not as a patch at the end.
cards.admin_text: Web and system solutions come with their own administration interface. You manage texts, products, orders or users yourself, without a programmer.
cards.support_text: We don't disappear after launch. We offer ongoing technical support, security updates and monitoring. If anything goes wrong, you know who to turn to.

about.story_heading: We build software that truly helps your company grow
about.story_text: We're not an agency that just builds you a website and then disappears. We focus on custom development across websites, desktop and mobile applications and solutions built on artificial intelligence - always with an emphasis on making the result actually solve your specific problem, not just look good in a presentation. From the first conversation through architecture design to deployment and long-term support, we are with you all the way as one team.
about.story_heading_2: Solutions that will grow with you for years to come

After launch we monitor performance, prepare updates and help with further development - so your solution stays fast, secure and ready for your company's new needs.

about_us.hero_sub: A digital studio focused on creating modern products — from websites to AI.
about_us.paragraph_1: RegioPartner s.r.o. has been active for more than 20 years in the field of evaluations and regional development planning. We focus on evaluating programmes and projects financed from public funds and on strategic territorial development planning. Thanks to this experience, we have built a stable background and expert know-how on which we are gradually building new activities.
about_us.paragraph_2: That is why in 2023 we founded a new division, RPsoftware, which extends the company's activities towards modern technologies. RPsoftware builds on the IT support previously provided to the parent company in the areas of questionnaire surveys, statistical data processing and other IT products. It now focuses on software development and digital solutions mainly for small and medium-sized enterprises, as well as for individuals who need a reliable partner for their IT projects.
about_us.paragraph_3: Our goal is to deliver software that is not only technically sound but also tailored to the specific needs of its users. We provide complete services – from analysis and solution design through the development itself to testing, implementation and long-term support.
about_us.paragraph_4: RPsoftware operates under the umbrella of RegioPartner s.r.o., which means it draws on the same professional background and values, while being a specialised division focused exclusively on IT. Combining both parts of the company allows us to bring together experience from evaluations and development planning in the public sphere with technological possibilities, and thus offer services with a broader context and added value.

m1.text: RPSW is created as the software division of the RegioPartner, s.r.o. group, building on the parent company's fifteen-year history.

m3.title: First external contracts
m3.text: We open up to clients outside the parent company and deliver our first custom websites, applications and AI solutions.

m4.title: Stable team, growing portfolio
m4.text: We combine the background of an established company with the flexibility of a smaller team and keep expanding our portfolio of completed projects.
